description: Implement a single task from a Next.js `implementation_plan.md`-style task list — the implementation, its tests, and its checkbox update. First detects the project's exact profile at runtime — the installed Next.js major (14, 15, or 16), App Router vs Pages Router (or both), whether `cacheComponents` is on (so the version/model profile is one of `14`, `15`, `16-prev`, `16-cc`), `src/` layout, `proxy.ts` vs `middleware.ts`, `output` mode (`export`/`standalone`), test runner (Vitest or Jest via `next/jest`, plus Playwright), styling approach, linter, and any project `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` guidance (including the version-matched docs bundled under `node_modules/next/dist/docs/`) — then loads only the matching guidance from this skill's own `reference/` directory: this catalog's TypeScript agreements plus Next-specific code style, Server vs Client Components, data fetching and caching organized by version/model (applying only the detected profile's rules), Server Actions, Route Handlers and the proxy, routing and rendering (special files, dynamic segments, `generateStaticParams`, SSG/SSR/ISR/PPR and route segment config per model, static-export constraints), metadata and SEO, the Pages Router, testing, security, and — for a task that adds or changes a page, component or list — the catalog's UI contract mapped onto Next.js (`Screen › Region › Component` decomposition; interactive Client Components fed serializable props by Server Components; lists through server pagination or a client `@tanstack/react-virtual` virtualizer; Playwright component tests against a standalone Vite gallery plus screen/flow tests against the production build, capturing `.ui-screenshots/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark with axe checks at the `.ui-quality.yml` level). Re-checks the current code state, implements exactly what the task specifies without changing any route's rendering mode the task didn't ask to change, writes/updates tests (does not run them), then — unless it stopped on a blocker — checks off this task's own checkbox in `implementation_plan.md` with a "group validation pending" note and reports the files touched, tests written, the expected `next build` classification (static/SSG/dynamic/partial) of every route it touched, and any deviation from `reference/`. Never runs tests, coverage, quality checks, license headers, or `next build` — those happen once per group in `iru-nextjs-code-one-task-group`. Invoke as `/iru-nextjs-code-one-task <task description>`, passing the task's own text including its exact `implementation_plan.md` checkbox line(s). The Next.js counterpart to `iru-typescript-code-one-task`.
